_doc: Rival crews, the city feed, property and heists. crews: standing -100..100 with you, relations between crews (war < -50 < cold < 50 < allied). events: weekly crew politics. feed: how the city's graffiti/pamphlet network and the radio report you (legend / villain / ghost). property: things you can own, with income and risk per day. roles: crew members you can hire. heists: multi-stage jobs; each stage has a goal type (reach, talk, wait, deliver, escape), a place, text and heat. All original to this world.

events.text: The Syndicate and Lowlight split a cargo of engine parts. Both claim they got the better half.
A Sundial boat rammed a Lowlight runner off the east channel. Lowlight is counting.
Portage Brokers raised dock fees for Rusthold hulls. The Syndicate sent a welder to 'discuss' it.
The Tideholders paid off a Lowlight debt nobody asked them to pay. Lowlight is suspicious of kindness.
A Sundial patron bought a raft at Portage and renamed it after himself. The Brokers took his money and his raft back.
Somebody betrayed somebody at the Drowned Rat. The saw player stopped mid-song.

legend: A FAST BOAT AND A FASTER MOUTH — chalked on the Portage seawall
Pamphlet: 'Who outran the Ward on Tuesday? Free Voice salutes you.'
Graffiti on a Highmark billboard: a little boat, three stars, and a grin.
villain: Ward notice: REWARD for information on an unregistered craft. Description: 'fast'.
Highmark Official asks: 'Is your neighbour a criminal? Probably.'
Somebody painted WANTED under a smudge on the ration board.
ghost: Nobody saw anything on the east channel. Nobody ever does.
A rumour with no name in it is going round three rafts at once.
Chalk on the Vigil steps: 'They went under. They came back. They said nothing.'

raft_club.name: A raft club at Portage
raft_club.desc: A barge, a band, a licence nobody checks. It makes money and enemies.

boat_yard.name: A boat yard at Rusthold
boat_yard.desc: Hulls in, hulls out. Some of them were yours to begin with.

front.name: A smuggling front: 'Vinegar & Sons'
front.desc: A stall at Greentide selling vinegar. Some of it is vinegar.

pilot.name: Vesna Kade
pilot.skill: Chase: +25% boost tank and the Ward loses you faster.
pilot.line: I don't do slow. I don't do 'careful'. I do 'there'.

diver.name: Dockmother Ree
diver.skill: Dives: the Ward can't see you underwater for 30% longer.
diver.line: I've been under more than I've been over. Let's go down.

forger.name: Silent Mo
forger.skill: Inspections: forged papers. Contraband found less often.

muscle.name: Bruno Tack
muscle.skill: Boarding: crews back off; brawls go your way.
muscle.line: You point. I lean on it.

hacker.name: Teagan Moss
hacker.skill: Radio: jam the Ward band for a minute (lose a star faster).
hacker.line: I wrote their jingles. I can write over them.

barge.name: The Highmark Supply Barge
barge.pitch: Every fifth night a Highmark supply barge runs the east channel: two guards, a captain who drinks, and a crate of real ration seals. Take the crate, and the Drift eats for a month.

stages.text: Scout the east channel at night. Count the guards. Watch the barge's lights.
Find out the captain's drink. Haddie knows everyone's poison.
Hire a pilot and a diver. You can't do this alone.
Hit the barge at the second bell. The diver cuts the anchor; you take the crate.
Lose the Ward. Then lose them again.
Get the crate to Lowlight. Fenn will know what to do with it.

barge.after: The ration boards are full for the first time in a year. Highmark says it was a clerical error. Everybody on the water knows whose error it was.

harbor.name: The Harbor Escape
harbor.pitch: The Syndicate's hydrofoil is impounded in the Ward harbour. Get it out. Through the harbour mouth, past the boom, under the guns.

stages.text: Get into the Ward harbour by the old Calla Morrow wreck.
Run the harbour mouth. Use the ramps.

harbor.after: Rustbelt Radio plays the hydrofoil's engine noise for a full minute without comment.
